room.emptyText: Write to everyone, or mention only the bots you want to answer.
room.unconfirmed: Not confirmed. Retry with the same identifier.
room.unsupported: Rooms need a Hermes gateway with group chats.
room.driverDown: The Hermes room driver is unavailable. Restart Hermes, then retry.
room.createFailed: The room could not be created.
room.sendFailed: The message was not confirmed. Retry it with the same identifier.
room.previousStillSending: The previous message is still sending.
room.logStalled: The room log stopped before the latest event.
room.notAdmitted: Hermes did not post the message. Edit it or try again.
room.stopFailed: The room could not be stopped.
room.roomCreated: Room created. No bot runs until you send a message.

menu.label: Actions for {{name}}
menu.renameHint: Every member sees the new name. The room history is not changed.
menu.deleteBody_one: This ends the room for its {{count}} member. It disappears from the list and cannot be reopened: Hermes retires its ID for good.
menu.deleteBody_other: This ends the room for all {{count}} members. It disappears from the list and cannot be reopened: Hermes retires its ID for good.
menu.deleteWorking: Bots are working in it now: Hermes stops that work first.
menu.deleteHistory: Hermes keeps the room's log for up to 90 days (sooner if it needs the space), then erases it.
menu.deleteBots: The bots themselves, their own conversations and their profiles are not touched.

errors.unsupported: This Hermes cannot do that (method missing). Update Hermes, then retry.
errors.retry: Hermes is still ending the room. Retry in a moment.
errors.peer: A member could not be reached, so Hermes did not delete the room. Retry when it is available.
errors.otherGateway: This room is managed by another Hermes gateway.
errors.stopPending: Hermes could not stop the room's work yet. Retry in a moment.
errors.offline: Hermes does not answer. Check the connection, then retry.
